name: Google Cloud Professional Agentic Architect

fee.note: US list price plus tax where applicable; Google says the certification costs $200. The $120 beta closed on 30 September 2026.

exam.format: Two parts: a 2-hour proctored exam of 50–60 multiple choice questions, delivered by Pearson online or at a test center, then two hands-on labs in Google Skills. Candidates who pass the exam get two months to finish the labs; both parts are needed to earn the certification.

scope: Designing agentic systems on Google Cloud.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Valid for one year, unlike the two years of Google Cloud's other professional certifications; Google says a continuing education path will keep it active.
Passing the exam alone does not certify: results arrive in 7–10 business days, and the labs must be completed within two months. If the labs are not finished in time, the exam has to be taken again.
Google reports pass/fail only and does not publish a passing score.

access.retake: Up to four attempts in two years: wait 14 days after the first failure, 60 after the second and 365 after the third. Failing the exam, or not finishing the labs within two months, means taking the exam again.

domains.name: Using coding agents for application development

domains_note: Weights from the Google Cloud Professional Agentic Architect exam guide (PDF dated 4 November 2026), read 2026-11-17; unchanged from the beta guide. Google marks each weight as approximate (~) and they cover the multiple-choice exam only; the required hands-on labs are separate and unweighted.
